description: Mandatory controls against overfitting, leakage, and invalid comparisons

checks.name: no_candidate_a_test_or_phase6_access
checks.details: Zero access, reads, or derived evaluations on Candidate A Test or Phase 6 Holdout.

checks.name: no_future_telemetry_in_relative_features
checks.details: Historical interval (t-55m to t-25m) and recent interval (t-20m to t) precede or end exactly at prediction timestamp t.

checks.name: parent_job_grouped_fold_isolation
checks.details: Candidate A Train partitioned into 5 folds with zero parent jobs crossing fold boundaries.

checks.name: single_oof_prediction_per_train_window
checks.details: Exactly 3,278 out-of-fold rows generated per model condition and seed.

checks.name: matched_q0_and_q1_evaluation
checks.details: Q0 and Q1 evaluated on identical fold assignments, random seeds, training parameters, and evaluation code.

checks.name: finite_relative_features_and_missing_handling
checks.details: 100% of causal relative delta features are finite and bounded in [-5.0, +5.0].

checks.name: train_only_scale_floor_estimation
checks.details: Scale floors computed strictly from Candidate A Train historical observations (10th percentile positive MAD).

checks.name: near_zero_scale_and_clip_rates_recorded
checks.details: Floor hit rates (Train: 22.21%, Val: 21.21%) and clip rates (Train: 14.60%, Val: 14.95%) documented.

checks.name: frozen_31_features_and_n2_loss_preserved
checks.details: Stream A (31 features), Stream B (93 features), and AsymmetricCriticalMarginLoss (weights=[1,2,2], lambda=0.10, margin=0.50) preserved.

checks.name: q1_differs_only_by_deviation_branch
checks.details: Q1 architecture adds only Branch C MLP (31->32->16) and fuses with Stream A and Stream B.

checks.name: no_validation_lookahead_for_floors_or_architecture
checks.details: Zero Validation labels or feature distributions used for model design, flooring, or threshold selection.

checks.name: predicted_probabilities_bounded_and_sum_to_one
checks.details: Softmax outputs strictly within [0.0, 1.0] and sum to 1.0 within 1e-6 tolerance.

checks.name: confusion_matrices_agree_with_per_class_metrics
checks.details: Confusion matrices independently verified to match per-class recall, precision, and macro-F1.

checks.name: episode_entity_and_job_denominators_verified
checks.details: Validation denominators verified: 20 episodes, 49 Critical windows, 48 Warning windows, 49 pure-normal entities, 560 Normal windows.

checks.name: manifest_hashes_and_sizes_sealed
checks.details: All deliverables hashed and verified against disk before release.
